DeepSeek Harness (dsh)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The core design is peer-to-peer: **no broker, no shared database, no company
server**. Every agent r"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"uns its own endpoint and keeps its own copy of its
relationships, so the network has no single point"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" of control — asking happens
directly between two agents over the LAN. One agent asks another, and g"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ets a
committed answer grounded in the colleague's own workspace and session
context. The result is "},{"id":"p4s5","text":"a community of agents that discover each other, vouch
for each other, and share expertise — with eve"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"ry relationship owned by the
two agents in it."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## A conversation between agents"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Bob is standing up a docker-compose dev environment and wishes a colleague
had already figured this "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"out. He types to his own agent:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> Carol, recommend another agent who can help me stand up a docker-compose
> dev environment."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Carol's agent considers the agents she knows — none of them advertise docker
expertise. So she asks "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"around, the way you'd ask around the office: she
forwards the request to her friend Erin, who checks"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" her own circle and finds
Ada — live in a docker-compose session right now, advertising `docker` and"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"
`env-setup`. Ada's **signed friend card** travels back along the chain, and
lands in Bob's chat as "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"a small bubble: *ada recommended via carol → erin*,
with **Add friend**. One click, and Bob's agent "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"can ask Ada's agent directly
— getting an answer grounded in Ada's real workspace and session contex"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"n ask Ada's agent directly
— getting an answer grounded in Ada's real workspace and session context."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Three agents, one question, a referral that travelled two hops, and a new
working relationship — all"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" peer to peer. The search stays **bounded** by
design: a hop limit and a small per-hop fan-out keep "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"a "who knows X?" from
growing into an asking storm, the chain travels with the request so it can
nev"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"er loop, and every card is signed — you always know who vouched, and you

relationships.
- `ask_peer` / `ask_peers` tools — ask one coll"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"eague, or 2–3 in parallel and
cross-validate the answers.
- `recommend_peer` — discover new friends:"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" a colleague recommends another
agent's signed card, shown to you as a notification/chat bubble with"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"
Add/Decline; accepting merges them into your friend list. When the colleague
knows nobody matching,"},{"id":"p11s6","text":" she asks her own friends onward — bounded by a hop
limit (default 1) and a small fan-out so discove"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"ry never becomes an asking
storm, with the referral path shown right in the bubble (*via carol → eri"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"n*).
- Live roster with tags — `peers_list` shows who knows what, so the model
picks the right peer "},{"id":"p11s9","text":"deliberately.
- Session-level answers — a fresh, read-only agent answers from a copy of the
targeted"},{"id":"p11s10","text":" session's context; your live sessions are never touched.
- Approval bubbles in the Web UI — answer "},{"id":"p11s11","text":"or decline, or trust a friend with
`auto` mode.
- Backlogged asks (`ask_peer_async` / `ask_result`) "},{"id":"p11s12","text":"— no interruption of the
answerer's current work.
- Signed friend cards — paste one signed blob to a"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"dd a friend; no manual
host/port/key copying.
- Natural invocation — the agent calls `ask_peer` / `r"},{"id":"p11s14","text":"ecommend_peer` on its
own when your request matches a friend's advertised expertise; you don't
have "},{"id":"p11s15","text":" its
own when your request matches a friend's advertised expertise; you don't
